content.short: Raffle Social lets Cardano users enter NFT raffles and lets projects run reward-based community draws.
content.description: Raffle Social is a Cardano-focused raffle platform for NFT communities and token projects. Users can enter draws to win NFTs, while project teams can create raffles to promote collections, reward holders, or build engagement around launches. The platform uses its TICKET mechanic to support participation in selected draws and also includes utility features such as token price tracking. Its purpose is to turn NFT giveaways and community promotions into a structured, wallet-based experience for Cardano users.
content.meta: Raffle Social supports Cardano NFT raffles, project promotions, and reward-based community draws. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
